unsupported: The company stocks what it describes as one of the largest collections of medium to high-end upholstery and drapery fabrics in the world, sourcing exclusive lines from international mills.
In addition to selling fabric by the yard, Fabric Factory runs a custom in-house workroom that produces made-to-measure draperies, upholstery, and other soft furnishings.
The retail space carries hundreds of patterns — including velvets, silk velvets, and printed cotton blends — priced per yard and displayed both in-store and online.
Customers include interior designers, professional upholsterers, drapery workrooms, and homeowners undertaking residential or commercial projects.
The showroom serves walk-in trade and ships orders placed through its e-commerce site.
The company emphasizes access to exclusive global textiles and the ability to move from selection to finished product without outsourcing the sewing work.
